title: Principal Architect - Data Governance
description:
Summary

The Principal Architect - Data Governance is responsible for shaping, positioning, and evangelizing Logicalis’ data governance and information protection strategy within its core IT portfolio. This role functions as a senior technical seller and trusted advisor, positioning data governance as a foundational IT and security capability that enables secure collaboration, regulatory compliance, risk reduction, and operational resilience.

This role works closely with Sales, the Overwatch Office, and the Security, Cloud, Modern Work, Hybrid Infrastructure, and Managed Services teams to ensure governance solutions are platform-aligned, commercially relevant, and clearly articulated to customers. The role focuses on pre-sales strategy, customer advisory, and technical alignment, and does not focus on analytics, BI, or data science.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Data Governance Strategy & Architecture

• Defines the enterprise data governance and information protection strategy aligned to core IT platforms with clear customer value propositions and use cases.

• Establishes governance architectures, patterns, and standards integrated with security, identity, cloud, and collaboration services including but not limited to:

• Microsoft 365 & Collaboration Platforms (Teams, SharePoint, Exchange, information protection, retention)

• Security Services and the Overwatch Office (data risk, executive visibility, compliance readiness, identity governance)

• Cloud and Hybrid Infrastructure Platforms

• Identity, Access Management, and Zero Trust Architectures

Portfolio & Offering Alignment

• Embeds governance consistently across existing practice portfolios and service offerings in a way that is easy for sellers and architects to position and explain.

• Identifies gaps and near-term enhancement opportunities aligned to supported platforms based on customer demand, market trends, and sales feedback.

• Establishes governance reference architectures, patterns, and tooling standards to support repeatable, scalable sales motions.

• Ensures governance integrates naturally with cloud, security, identity, and operations without creating standalone, delivery-heavy engagements.

Sales Enablement & Customer Advisory

• Serves as a senior technical seller and advisor for governance-related customer engagements.

• Partners with Sales to shape deals, influence strategy, and articulate governance value in early-stage customer conversations.

• Enables Sales and Architects with clear, outcome-focused governance narratives, positioning guidance, and use-case-driven storytelling.

• Leads or supports executive-level customer discussions, workshops, and roadmap conversations related to data governance and information protection.

• Raises governance fluency across Solution and Field Architects, ensuring they can confidently sell-not just deliver-governance solutions.

• Provides architectural oversight and escalation in support of deal success and customer confidence.

• Ensures consistency across sales, delivery, and managed services teams while keeping customer-facing messaging simple, practical, and commercial.

General

• Demonstrates and actively promotes an understanding and commitment to the mission of Logicalis through performing behaviors consistent with the organization's values.

• Maintains a working knowledge of applicable Federal, State, and Local laws and regulations as well as policies and procedures of Logicalis to ensure adherence in a manner that reflects honest, ethical and professional behaviors.

• Supports and conducts self in a manner consistent with customer service expectations.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Qualifications

title: [US DC] Senior Safety Specialist
description:

• Act as the management team’s subject matter expert for safety and security questions

• Promote safer forklift operations through training, observation and coaching operators

• Develop training materials including toolbox talks, standard operating procedures (SOP’s) and others

• Manage the relationship with site security and ensures security services are being provided for each DC

• Support other departments including quality, food safety, production and logistics as needed

• Use continuous improvement principles to identify ways to improve our processes and results

• Programmatic: able to identify the system component that is causing the error, as well as the options available for resolving it and completing the task.

• Inspirational: you know how to make an impact and deliver presentations that inspire and influence change

• Versatile: you roll with the punches and don’t get overwhelmed easily; you enjoy grinding away at issues and have a knack for driving results in hyper-growth, constantly changing environments

You have…

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in occupational safety experience with knowledge of manufacturing/industrial EHS

• Preferred Safety Certification: CSP, ASP, OHST, etc.

• Expertise in OSHA compliance, especially with powered industrial trucks, lockout/tagout, strain and sprain prevention.

title: BP141 Design Assurance Engineer
description:
Design Assurance Engineer responsible for undertaking National Grid BP141 design assurance roles on a variety of National Grid projects. This role ensures that designs for a variety of installations, asset replacements, connection schemes and substation builds comply with National Grid technical specifications, engineering standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
The successful candidate will work closely with National Grid Project Teams, DNO’s & Contractors, to support the timely delivery of safe, reliable, and compliant designs.
Experience of the UK Electricity Transmission and/or Distribution System is essential for this role.
We are looking for all Design Assurance Disciplines;

• HV Plant

• Substation Civil

• Protection & Control

• Relay Settings

• HV Cable

• Overhead Lines

• Commissioning Officer

Responsibilities
Design Review & Design Compliance Assurance Audit Report (DCAAR) acceptance:

• Review and assess design submissions, ensuring compliance with National Grid, technical specifications, procedures and engineering standards.

• Provide detailed feedback and recommendations to address design gaps, non-compliance, or potential risks.

• Support completion of design pack DCAAR once all technical, safety, and regulatory requirements are met.

• Engage in regular project design review meetings with a variety of stakeholders.

• Coordination and technical interface with other design assurance engineering disciplines.

Stakeholder Coordination:

• Serve as the primary point of contact between National Grid’s Project Team and Contractor Design Teams regarding design matters.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including asset management, project delivery teams, and other engineering disciplines, to ensure design alignment with project objectives.

• Participate in design coordination meetings, workshops, and technical reviews with contractors and suppliers.

Risk Identification & Mitigation:

• Identify potential risks related to safety, reliability, and performance in contractor designs and recommend corrective actions.

• Ensure that Contractor Design Teams have incorporated appropriate risk mitigation measures.

• Experience of implementing safety by design and CDM awareness.

Documentation & Reporting:

• Maintain comprehensive records of design submissions, review comments and DCAAR acceptances in accordance with BP188.

• Review technical reports and assurance documentation related to design pack submission.

• Monitor performance related to design quality and compliance, providing feedback to management as needed.

• Experience of working to a structured project design process and compliance with associated BP188 timescales to support the project.

Essential:

• HNC or Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or a related discipline.

• Currently or previously held National Grid BP141 Design Assurance Engineer authorisation

• Chartered Engineer status or working towards CEng accreditation

• Proven experience in infrastructure design, design assurance, or technical approval within the Electricity Transmission and/or DNO sector.

• Strong knowledge of electrical infrastructure, relevant to the specific assurance discipline.
Desirable:

• Experience of producing, reviewing and approving designs for National Grid and/or Distribution Network Operator (DNO) projects.

• Currently or previously nominated as SR188 Contractor Design Approval Engineer on National Grid projects.

title: Network Architect
description:
Company Description
Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.
We are seeking our next Network Architect to join our team! Our ideal candidate is a subject matter expert for multiple technologies relevant to the Zayo Enterprise Networks, which is an MPLS based multi-service backbone supporting layer 2 and layer 3 products and services. You will have experience designing, implementing, and documenting new technologies, as well as providing a top tier of troubleshooting and support for customers.
This is a hands-on position. You will build a network, not white papers. You will know when to apply cheap and cheerful versus large-scale, heavy-duty solutions. In your previous role, you will have been responsible for providing guidance with network architecture, Ethernet and IP product design standards and enhancements, production network issues and escalations, and to engage in vendor relationships. You will face both scaling the network and providing additional features necessary for the Zayo Ethernet & IP services that our customers demand. You will be at a vendor level engineering knowledge. You will have and be expected to invent novel and original solutions to difficult problems.
                
Responsibilities:

• Take responsibility for the analysis, definition, and continued development of the end-to-end Layer 2 & Layer 3 Architecture for Zayo

• Work with other team members and groups to develop scalable network designs, solutions and policy recommendations

• Analyze and drive key platform decisions and directions, provide guidance to network planning and operations groups

• Support Zayo's internal product groups by identifying and presenting their network-impacting requirements to the service activations and the network operations teams

• Support and lead development of Zayo's growing network infrastructure through published Architecture design documents

• Provide technical guidance for the NCC support teams

• Conduct extensive lab testing of new architectures, platforms, inter-networking software

• Promote Zayo’s Enterprise Networks product development

• Participate in discussions at various Standard Development Organizations such as NANOG, MEF, IETF and other conferences
Qualifications:

• Deep and substantial operational knowledge and experience with carrier-class routers, switches, and packet-optical platforms, such as Juniper, Cisco, Nokia-ALU, Infinera, and Ciena/Cyan

• Ability in representing Zayo at the Standards Development Organizations such as MEF, IEEE, ITU, IETF, ISO, etc.

• Excellent knowledge of the Ethernet, QOS, MPLS/RSVP-TE, L2Circuit/VLL, VPLS-BGP/LDP, L3VPN, G.8032v2, E-OAM, Y.1731, IS-IS, OSPF, MP-BGP, and SNMP protocols

• Skills in building Layer 2 & Layer 3 networks in both metro and long-haul applications. Experience modeling financial impacts of decisions

• Strong vendor negotiation skills

• Skills in Perl/Python scripting, automation, NETCONF/YANG, and EMS/NMS

• Strong written and oral communications skills with the ability to influence others with your engineering solutions
Education & Experience:

• Bachelor's Degree from a four-year college or university or equivalent experience

• Minimum of six (6) years of experience in engineering, architecture, or design of an ISP network

• Preferred Certification - JNCIE, CCIE, or MEF-CECP

• Other network related certifications a plus

• Must have worked in “zero downtime” environments previously

title: Category Growth Manager, Women's Hormones
description:
About AgelessRx

AgelessRx is a first-of-its-kind, longevity-focused telehealth platform with an e-commerce component. Our mission is to collectively give people millions of extra healthy years, so everyone can enjoy more of what they love in a world where people are empowered to live as long as they want. We believe aging should no longer be treated as a dreadful inevitability, but instead, as a puzzle that can be solved, a fight that can be fought - just as a disease with a cure. Through our free-to-use platform, we offer trusted, data-driven longevity solutions and scientifically backed prescription therapies to help safely lower the risk of age-related diseases.

About the role
AgelessRx is seeking a Category Growth Manager to own the strategy, growth, and commercial performance of key telehealth and longevity categories.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who can operate like a category owner: deeply understand the customer and market, identify where the biggest opportunities exist, develop a clear point of view on how AgelessRx should compete and differentiate, and bring together the right teams to turn those insights into measurable growth.

You will develop a deep understanding of your category - from the competitive landscape and customer needs to positioning, pricing, acquisition, conversion, retention, product experience, and unit economics. You will continuously talk to customers, study the market, evaluate the patient journey, analyze performance, and identify what needs to improve.

We are looking for someone who combines commercial judgment, customer obsession, analytical rigor, product thinking, and hands-on execution. You should be equally comfortable interviewing customers, analyzing a funnel, developing positioning, evaluating pricing or packaging, building a business case, launching an experiment, and driving a cross-functional initiative from idea through execution.

This role is intentionally broad. We want someone with high agency who can create structure where it does not yet exist, move quickly from insight to action, and become the internal owner and expert for their category.

What you'll do

Category Strategy & Commercial Performance

• Own the strategy and growth of Women’s Hormones, including clear goals, priorities, performance metrics, and growth plans.

• Develop a category strategy informed by market opportunity, customer needs, competitive dynamics, clinical considerations, and AgelessRx 's broader business strategy.

• Build a deep understanding of category performance and economics, including revenue, conversion, activation, CAC, LTV, retention, margin, payback, and ROI.

• Identify the biggest opportunities and constraints to growth and translate them into clear priorities and recommendations.

• Evaluate opportunities across pricing, packaging, offers, bundling, positioning, customer segments, and the broader category business model.

• Build business cases and make recommendations about where AgelessRx should invest, test, expand, or change direction.

Customer, Market & Competitive Insight

• Become the internal expert on the category, customer, and competitive landscape.

• Build an ongoing customer feedback loop through interviews, user testing, surveys, behavioral data, Customer Experience insights, and other qualitative and quantitative research.

• Develop a deep understanding of what customers need, how they make decisions, why they choose AgelessRx or a competitor, and where their experience falls short.

• Continuously evaluate competitors, including their positioning, products, pricing, customer experience, strengths, weaknesses, and emerging strategies.

• Identify unmet customer needs and market gaps that can become differentiated AgelessRx offerings.

• Translate customer and market insights into actionable recommendations for Marketing, Product, Clinical, and Operations.

Offering & Customer Journey

• Own the category experience across the customer journey

Richard turned a $500 digital product into an 8-figure online education company. He now teaches other people how to build online businesses, documenting the journey as he goes. The brand is impact-driven, scaling fast, and aiming to become one of the most influential voices in business education.

• Main channel:
Read this first
You'd be writing at least four scripts a week for a channel that already works.
70k+ subscribers in AI and business. A real company behind it: the videos drive revenue, not ad pennies. There's a filming schedule that doesn't slip, a full editing team, a dedicated thumbnail designer, and an ideation and scripting system that took this channel from zero to where it is now.
What that means for you: every script you write gets made and shipped. You'll know within 72 hours of posting whether your idea worked, and you'll get that feedback loop over 100 times a year.
Most writers get 30 shots a year, half of them into channels nobody watches. If you want to get genuinely great at this, rep count on a channel with distribution is the entire game.
What you'd actually do day to day
Roughly 50% ideation, 30% scripting, 20% QC.
Ideation. You'll generate a lot of concepts to find the few that are great: angles, titles, formats. Then filter hard. We have a proven process and we'll teach it to you. What we can't teach is the instinct underneath it: knowing why a video worked, feeling when a format is fatiguing, spotting an outlier on someone else's channel and understanding what's actually transferable.
Scripting. Four a week. Three for the main business channel, one for our AI-avatar channel. Our method is systematic, not vibes. We study what's already working, extract the psychological framework doing the heavy lifting, and retrofit it to our own audience and offers. It's been refined across dozens of videos. You'll learn it, then run it.
QC. You'll take the first two passes on each edit. Did the hook land, did the pacing hold, did the retention structure survive? Timestamped notes to the editors. The final pass stays with the Head of YouTube. It's the simplest part of the job, and it's yours because the person who wrote the script is the person who notices when the edit lost the plot. Long-form for now; short-form QC will likely fold in as that output scales.
You'll work directly with the Head of YouTube, the editing team, and the thumbnail designer, with a weekly 1:1 to pressure-test your reads.
What you'd be measured on
Median views per video, how many outliers we produce per quarter, and retention. Not hours logged. Your performance pay is tied to the same numbers, so we're reading the same scoreboard you are.
Requirements
You've written long-form YouTube scripts that performed, and you can explain why they performed. Send the links and the numbers.
You can hand us a video from any channel and reverse-engineer it out loud: what the hook is doing, where the open loops sit, why the audience stayed.
You watch YouTube like an operator. You have opinions about packaging. You notice when a channel changes format, and you have a theory about why.
You genuinely like writing. Hooks, structure, the sentence-level work. It's the part you'd do anyway.
You can hit volume without dropping quality, and you take editorial notes without friction.
You write English at a native or near-native level. This is copywriting for a US audience; the voice has to be seamless.
You can overlap at least 4 hours a day with US Eastern business hours, wherever you're based.
Bonus:

• Experience writing for AI-avatar or faceless channels

• Direct-response background: VSLs, emails, ads, webinars

• Enough editing li

title: AI Full Stack Engineer
description:
SoSafe is Europe's leading human risk management company, trusted by 6,000+ organisations to turn their people into a line of defence against cyberattacks. We've built something real, and we're nowhere near done.

This role is on the Adaptive Defence team, SoSafe’s newest most innovative product where we build products fast, AI-native from day zero, and we put it in front of customers before it's perfect. We iterate in fast cycles. We're not here to maintain a roadmap. We're here to build what's next.

We've got the distribution, the customers, and the brand. What we need are builders: people who've taken something from 0 to 1, who prototype before they specify, who use AI to move faster, and who have no patience for process for its own sake.

Title and years don't decide this. What you've shipped does. If you're a builder, let's talk.

Location: Hybrid from Lisbon.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 

SHIP, DON'T SPECIFY

- Own a product problem end to end: from framing to prototype to production.

- Move in short cycles. Days and weeks, not quarters. Your output is working software in users' hands, not decks.

- Own the feedback loop. Get in front of customers, learn, and ship the next version fast.

BUILD AI-NATIVE

- Agentic coding and rapid prototyping are your default, not a side experiment.

- You're a multiplier: you ship at a pace a conventional team can't match.

- You'll help shape how we build with AI. That's a happy side effect, not the mission. The product is.

- Our stack is TypeScript, React, Node, and AWS. We care more about how fast you ramp than what you know today.

OWN THE OUTCOME

- You own the quality bar and the judgement behind what you build, not just the output.

- Make product, design, and scope calls without waiting for a committee, and own them when you're wrong.

- When the brief is incomplete, you narrow it yourself and move.

- Your name's on what ships. You're measured on impact, not tickets closed.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- You've built 0 to 1. You've taken something from nothing to shipped, and you can point to the calls you owned and what came of them. Founder, indie builder, or early employee with outsized scope all count. Coordinating other people's work doesn't.

- You're hungry and not afraid. New domain, new stack, hard problem: you run at it. You'd rather ship something imperfect and learn than polish something that never ships.

- You build AI-native. AI tools are core to how you work, not an add-on. You have opinions on what's actually useful, and the scars to back them. Tool-agnostic on the way in; you'll converge with the team here.

- You keep your edge inside a structure. You've done things your own way. You know the difference between autonomy, which you'll have, and authority over everything, which nobody has.

 

STRONG SIGNALS

- You've prototyped something real and put it in front of users in days.

- You've built your own tooling or workflow to go faster, and you can show it.

- You've got taste: a point of view on what great security or B2B SaaS looks like.

- You've lived startup or early-stage, where nothing works until you make it work.

- You actually care about human risk and cybersecurity, not just the market.

The University of Tennessee's Office of Innovative Technologies is seeking a Senior Research Consultant to lead the design, execution, and analysis of research projects in support of faculty and graduate researchers across campus. The position also solves complex computing problems by selecting and configuring appropriate software and hardware, writing and debugging code, mentoring colleagues through workshops and one-on-one consultations on advanced statistical and computing methods, and managing university research software licensing.
The ideal candidate holds a master's degree (Ph.D. preferred) and seven or more years of experience as a statistician, data scientist, or research analyst, with a record of peer-reviewed publications. The candidate will also possess strong programming and analytical skills across tools such as R, Python, SAS, SPSS, Stata, MATLAB, ArcGIS and JMP along with deep knowledge of statistical methodology, data visualization, and the mathematical foundations underlying advanced analytic techniques. This role carries significant influence over departmental research strategy and direction, serves as backup for the manager when needed, requires occasional overnight travel, and operates with a high degree of autonomy, consulting with a supervisor primarily on priorities and complex or high-impact matters.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
YOUR IMPACT

Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part isn't the software. Every customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that's where most enterprise AI value quietly dies.

At Tacto, the people who close that gap are Builders who work at the customer edge. You sit inside the customer's environment, build in their production data, and turn what you learn there into product. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto, and every new one teaches us something the platform should do on its own.

 

YOUR TASKS

- Prove it with their data. Show a prospect or customer what Tacto finds in their own spend, suppliers and parts, fast enough that the value is obvious.

- Build in customer environments. Data pipelines, agents and custom logic on top of the Tacto platform, in real production data, until the procurement team can actually work with the result.

- Be in the room, on site. Run workshops with buyers and key users, debug alongside their IT, and see how a company really buys instead of how the process documentation says it buys.

- Turn the edge into product. When you solve something twice, ship it into the platform so nobody has to solve it a third time. You're done when it drives revenue, not when the deployment is live.

- Automate your own job. If a step can be done by an agent, you build the agent and prove it works.

 

YOUR PROFILE

- You've built something people relied on: software, automations, agents, or a technical project that real users used.

- You build with AI every day. Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents are your default, and you've built with LLMs against real, messy data.

- You're hands-on with data. SQL and Python at working level, or the drive to get there fast with AI as leverage.

- You thrive in messy environments. Incomplete requirements, undocumented data and conflicting stakeholders don't stop you.

- You earn customer trust. You explain technical decisions clearly, handle pushback, and don't over-promise.

- Early in your career? Good. We bet on people with a steep learning curve, and our senior Builders spend real time making others faster.

- Native-level German and fluent English, based in Munich, happy to travel across DACH.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE IS, AND ISN'T

We want to be honest about what you are signing up for.

- This is not an engineering role with customers kept at a safe distance. Customer contact is the job, not a tax on the job. If you want a ticket queue and clean requirements, this is the wrong role.

- This is not consulting. Nobody here bills days. You are measured on what the customer can do afterwards and on what made it into the platform.

- It is deliberately broad. If you want to specialise narrowly you will be frustrated here.

- The deal: prove yourself, deliver real impact, make a strong case for yourself, then we back your next step in every way we can.

HOW THE PROCESS WORKS

1. Say Hello (20 min): get to know each other and the role

2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 min)

3. On-site day: a case with three Builders and Pool Leads (1 hour), Meet the Team (30 min)

OUR BACKGROUND

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

title: Climate Program Manager
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

To avoid the worst effects of climate change, most climate models agree the world will need to dramatically reduce emissions and remove 5-10 billion tons of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere per year by 2050. The Climate team’s goal is to accelerate Stripe’s path to net zero in parallel with the world’s. We do this by reducing Stripe’s emissions and leading initiatives to increase the likelihood that we have the global carbon removal capacity necessary to reach these climate goals.

In 2019, we developed the first measurement of Stripe’s enterprise emissions. In 2021 we launched Stripe Climate , enabling merchants to direct a fraction of their revenue to help scale emerging carbon removal technologies. In 2022 we launched Frontier , an advance market commitment to buy $1.8B+ of permanent carbon removal by 2040. In 2024, we entered our first multi-year offtake for clean energy.

Today, Stripe’s corporate net zero program is entering a new phase. We are looking to streamline our emissions measurement, create a template for catalytic emission reduction and champion buying removals on the path to net zero, all while meeting our expanding global ESG disclosure requirements.

What you’ll do

As Stripe’s Climate Program Manager, you will set the strategy and lead the execution and reporting for Stripe’s corporate net zero program. You’ll partner with a wide range of stakeholders within and outside of Stripe - Accounting, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Facilities, Sales, and carbon accounting and assurance providers - to refine our greenhouse gas inventory, deliver a reduction and removal roadmap that meets our climate targets, and provide inputs to global ESG disclosures.

This role requires someone with expertise in carbon accounting and reductions strategy, sharp program and process management, a track record of getting big things done fast, and excellent judgement to make the ‘right’ recommendations for Stripe’s net zero program.

Responsibilities

• Net Zero strategy (~15%): Own and evolve Stripe’s corporate net zero strategy, including Stripe’s transition plan, priorities, budget, annual goals, emissions forecasts, removal retirements, and progress tracking. Stay current on evolving disclosure requirements, net zero guidance, and industry best practices to ensure Stripe’s program is high impact and best in class 

• Emissions measurement (~30%): Build Stripe’s annual greenhouse gas inventory. Collect data inputs, evolve methodology, manage Stripe’s footprint vendors, run a rigorous and auditable process with cross-functional stakeholders, and identify opportunities to use AI to improve the accuracy and efficiency of this process

• Emissions reporting (~30%):  Serve as Stripe’s subject-matter expert to deliver inputs to ESG controllership for regulatory disclosures and clear recommendations for executives and customers

• Reduction program (~25%): Develop and manage emissions reduction initiatives across Stripe. This will include efforts like securing renewable electricity for Stripe’s scope 2 emissions, as well as driving creative and high-impact interventions like carbon removal or lower-emission data centers that we need to reach global net zero

The Agent Platform team at OpenAI builds the production systems that bring useful AI agents to users around the world. We provide the platform that enables agents to execute code, use tools, and interact with software reliably and securely at scale.

We work closely with product, research, and infrastructure teams to turn new agent capabilities into dependable product experiences. Our work spans the execution environments, APIs, and integrations that support agentic products such as Codex and tool use in ChatGPT.

We focus on how agents run in production: making it easy to launch new capabilities, supporting growing demand, and improving the performance and reliability of the systems behind user experiences.

Some of the hardest problems in making agents useful emerge when they meet real-world workloads. We build the platform that helps agents handle those workloads safely, recover when things go wrong, and deliver consistent results.

As a Software Engineer on the Agent Platform team, you will build and scale the services that power agentic products at OpenAI. You’ll work closely with product engineers, researchers, and infrastructure engineers to bring new capabilities from early prototypes to production.

Your work will include designing APIs and services, improving agent execution and orchestration, and building the integrations needed to support increasingly capable agents. You’ll help launch new experiences while strengthening the reliability, observability, and efficiency of the platform underneath them.

We’re looking for engineers with experience building large-scale backend systems or infrastructure who enjoy working close to products and users. - Partner with product, research, security, and infrastructure teams to bring new agent capabilities into production.

- Own systems through their full lifecycle, from design and implementation to rollout, monitoring, and ongoing operation.

- Have experience building and operating large-scale backend services, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure.

- Enjoy building shared platforms and APIs that help other engineers move faster.

- Have a strong understanding of system performance, concurrency, failure modes, and resource management.

- Are comfortable working across service boundaries and collaborating with teams to solve problems from end to end.

- Are interested in secure execution environments, sandboxing, and the challenges of running agent workloads in production.

title: Director Account Management / Client Service
Senior Product Owner/Manager, Next Best Action Configuration
description:
Become a part of our caring community

Become a part of our caring community

Join a world-class marketing organization creating the best possible engagement experience for millions of members.

Humana is a $100+ billion, Fortune 50 healthcare leader dedicated to improving the health and well-being of some of the most vulnerable populations in the United States, including seniors, people with disabilities, and lower-income Americans. Humana is uniquely positioned to transform healthcare delivery by making high-quality care more affordable, accessible, and secure through integrated healthcare services, innovative technology, and data-driven solutions.

To help deliver on this mission, we are seeking a Product Owner to support the continued expansion of Humana 's enterprise Next Best Action (NBA) decisioning capability. As part of the NBA product organization, this role will serve as the bridge between product strategy and implementation by translating approved actions, treatments, and business requirements into complete, standardized, implementation-ready documentation. Working closely with NBA Product Managers and configuration teams, the Product Owner will ensure requirements are clearly defined, internally consistent, and sufficiently detailed to support successful implementation within the NBA platform.

This role will help establish and maintain the standards, documentation, and operational practices that support scalable action configuration as the NBA platform continues to expand across new use cases, channels, and business areas. Role Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary point of coordination between NBA Product Managers and teams responsible for implementing action and treatment configurations.

• Translate approved business requirements into standardized, implementation-ready documentation that supports efficient configuration and deployment.

• Ensure actions and treatments are fully defined, documented, and aligned with established NBA standards before implementation begins.

• Manage documentation associated with action metadata, eligibility criteria, channel availability, treatments, content references, business rules, and related configuration requirements.

• Review requirements for completeness, consistency, and implementation readiness and identify gaps, conflicts, or ambiguities requiring resolution.

• Partner with Product Managers to obtain missing information, clarify intent, and resolve outstanding requirement questions.

• Maintain accurate documentation as actions, treatments, business rules, channels, and content requirements evolve over time.

• Support backlog management activities for configuration work, aligning priorities with direction provided by NBA Product Management.

• Track implementation progress and help ensure open requirement questions are resolved in a timely manner.

• Provide clarification and guidance to implementation teams regarding documented requirements and expected behavior.

• Support change management activities by updating requirements and documentation as approved modifications are introduced.

• Maintain visibility into actions and treatments moving through definition, configuration, testing, and implementation.

• Identify recurring documentation challenges and recommend improvements to templates, standards, and requirement-management practices.

• Support ongoing evolution of the NBA Action Catalog and related implementation standards.

• Contribute to the development of scalable documentation and configuration practices that enable broader adoption of NBA capabilities across the enterprise.

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• Demonstrated experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Product Management, Requirements Management, Platform Administration, or a related role.

title: Commercial counsel
description:
🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com.

📐 About the role

We’re looking for a commercial counsel who thrives on deal-making and loves turning legal complexity into business clarity. In this role, you’ll be the trusted legal partner to our sales and procurement functions, reporting to our head of commercial legal. You’ll be drafting and negotiating SaaS agreements that power our growth and keep our partnerships strong. If you’re energized by fast-paced negotiations with large enterprise companies, curious about cutting-edge technology, and excited to join a small-but-mighty team that values creativity and collaboration (all with a sense of humor and low ego) then, this may be the role for you. Come help us redefine what it means to be an in-house legal team - and have fun doing it.

🦸🏻‍♀️ What you’ll do

- Review and negotiate inbound and outbound commercial contracts, including inbound and outbound SaaS licensing agreements, strategic partnership agreements, data processing agreements and other important contracts with our enterprise customers and suppliers.

- Develop and manage various contract templates and negotiation playbooks and improve efficiency of sales contracting processes in collaboration with sales operations.

- Create thoughtful processes that benefit the business (not just legal) and how we support our internal stakeholders as we grow and scale - If you see something that doesn’t work, or could be better, we want you to help fix it!

- Enable and train our go-to-market teammates by giving them practicable advice and guidance.

⭐️ What you need

- A law degree from an accredited law school and admitted to practice law in the U.S.

- 3+ years of experience negotiating commercial contracts, ideally at a SaaS company and/or law firm servicing tech industry clients.

- Experience contracting with large enterprise companies and strategic partners, often in heavily-regulated industries (finance, healthcare, insurance). Bonus points if you’ve supported a global sales team with international offices.

- Exposure to privacy, IP, and/or AI-specific legal issues, with a basic understanding of AI. We don’t need you to be an expert, but it helps if you know the basics.

- Experience using contract management tools, in particular to help legal teams like ours continue to be data-driven.

- Familiarity with legal operations, project management and CLM tools like Asana, Salesforce, Linksquares, etc.

- A strong work ethic, the ability to think on your feet, and a sense of humor - we work hard, but we know how to have fun.

- You are:

- A business person first that also happens to be a lawyer.

- Someone who can explain complex legal concepts in a non-legal way.

- A redline machine! The end-of-month, quarter and year push is real, and we work fast under tight deadlines. Efficiency and the ability to prioritize and multi-task are must-haves.

- A self-starter, who finds ways to add value without being told.

- A partner - not a roadblock. We get things done!

- Curious, reliable, comfortable

description:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios - empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries - and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations - and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works - join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll lead the group-level QA team that supports engineering across all SINGU products, and you’ll stay hands-on. This is a player-coach role: a significant part of your week goes into writing and reviewing test code, while you also own the team’s goals, not just its calendar.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Hands-on:

- Build and maintain automated tests across multiple products: web and API as the baseline, with depth in performance, accessibility or mobile depending on your strengths

- Write tests in Playwright (TypeScript) and ship them through Jenkins / Bitbucket Pipelines

- Set up new automation projects from scratch and review the team’s test code

- Act as the safety net for ongoing refactoring and migration of a legacy PHP / .NET codebase

- Drive adoption of AI tools and practices in QA workflows, from test generation to analysis

Leading the team:

- Lead a team of QA engineers: priorities, workload, 1:1s, development, hiring

- Take ownership of the team’s goals and report on quality (coverage, escaped defects, automation progress) to engineering leadership

- Define and raise QA standards and practices across the group

- Be the QA counterpart for dev teams and product: you decide what gets tested, how and when

- Coordinate external penetration testing: scope, communication with dev teams, and retests

YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF:

- You’ve shipped production test automation as a Senior QA Engineer and still write code every week

- You’ve led a QA team or been the de facto lead: planning, feedback, accountability for results

- You’re fluent in Playwright or Cypress in TypeScript and comfortable with API testing (REST, HTTP, JSON)

- You know your way around CI/CD (Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines or similar)

- You take ownership and don’t need a fully laid-out playbook

- You use AI tools in your daily work and know where they help, and where they don’t

- You speak fluent Polish and English (B2/C1), both used daily across the group

NICE TO HAVE:

- Performance testing (k6, JMeter, Gatling) or accessibility testing

- Experience building a QA function or automation strategy from zero

- Security testing in a QA context (OWASP Top 10, ZAP)

WHAT WE OFFER:

- Salary range 16 600 - 20 300 gross (UoP) or 20 000 - 24 500 PLN net on B2B + VAT

- The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing international SaaS company shaping the future of real estate operations.

- A role with real ownership and operational impact, where your work directly supports the efficiency of the entire organization.

- A collaborative and international environment, working with teams across multiple countries.

- The chance to improve and build processes in a scaling organization.

 

- A supportive culture built on adaptability,

title: Tech Lead, AI Data Products
description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise.

We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real-world workflows.

Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real-world application. We’re solving problems few companies have encountered, with the opportunity to influence what the world’s most advanced AI systems become capable of doing. We’re looking for people who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard. You’ll have the opportunity to do consequential work alongside talented colleagues who challenge one another, collaborate openly, and share a commitment to excellence.

Mercor is profitable and recently raised a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation. We work in person five days a week in San Francisco, New York, and London.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Frontier models increasingly depend on data that goes beyond text: images, video, audio, documents, and combinations of these modalities. Turning that raw material into useful data products is technically difficult. Each modality has different formats, quality failures, processing costs, privacy considerations, and review workflows. The final product still needs to be consistent, traceable, and trustworthy. Mercor’s Frontier Data Products team builds the systems that make these products possible.

As Tech Lead Manager, you will lead the team responsible for turning complex multimodal inputs into reliable, customer-ready data products at scale. This is a player-coach role, split roughly evenly between technical contribution and people leadership. You will write and review production code, own important architecture decisions, and help resolve the hardest production problems.

You will also hire, coach, and organize a team that can operate with clear ownership and strong independent judgment. This is a product-engineering leadership role. Applied ML is part of the system, but success is measured by the quality, reliability, and usefulness of the products delivered-not by research output alone

What You’ll Do

- Set the technical and product strategy for Mercor’s multimodal data products.

- Design systems that support the full lifecycle of image, video, audio, document, and mixed-media data-from initial inputs through processing, review, validation, versioning, and delivery.

- Create reusable abstractions across modalities while preserving the differences that matter for quality, performance, and customer requirements.

- Build quality systems that combine automated evaluation, model-assisted checks, expert review, sampling, and adjudication.

- Ensure that every output is traceable: what produced it, what changed, how it was evaluated, and why it was accepted.

- Own the reliability, performance, and cost of storage-heavy, compute-intensive, long-running workflows.

- Stay hands-on by writing production code, leading design reviews, and directly contributing to the team’s most consequential technical work.

- Manage and develop engineers through clear expectations, frequent feedback, thoughtful delegation, and meaningful ownership.

8x8 connects our customers and teams globally. You will own the platform's dependency map and shared-infrastructure inventory, set the operational standards every service is held to, and prove through regular testing that failover works. • Own capacity planning and performance engineering for shared infrastructure and high-traffic services.

• Lead resilience and disaster recovery programs, including regular failover testing across data centers and game days for critical components.

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

This is a hybrid, office-based role. Candidates must live within commuting distance of our Paris office and be able to work on site as required.

The Account Executive - Acquisition will be responsible for acquiring new enterprise customers in France.

Individuals who excel at this job have the ability to prospect, develop, and close business within a timely manner while focusing on the clients’ requirements.

This role is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high-visibility, high-impact projects at a very exciting time for the company. Snowflake is an innovative, high-growth, customer-focused company operating in a large and growing market.

If you are an energetic, self-managed professional with experience managing complex sales processes, and you possess excellent presentation, listening, organizational, and contact management skills, we’d love to hear from you.

AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

- Achieve quarterly and annual quota across assigned territory by executing targeted regional sales plans and strategic prospect acquisition.

- Develop marketing plans with the marketing team to drive revenue growth.

- Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap to drive the Snowflake solution within the marketplace.

- Identify and qualify key prospects to expand the sales pipeline and drive ongoing revenue growth.

- Arrange and conduct initial Executive and CxO discussions and positioning meetings.

- Drive the end-to-end sales cycle from pipeline management through to final deal closure.

- Execute a consultative, solution-based sales methodology while navigating complex sales processes with superior presentation, listening, and organizational skills.

OUR IDEAL ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE WILL HAVE:

- 7+ years of field sales experience (data or cloud technology preferred).

- A proven ability to independently develop, manage, and close net-new client relationships.

- Demonstrated experience hitting annual quotas of $600K+ ARR.

- A consistent track record of driving sales activity, pipeline development, and quota attainment.

- Proven consultative experience diagnosing customer requirements and presenting tailored solutions.

- Strategic business acumen, with the ability to see the "bigger picture" and understand core IT business drivers.

- Executive-level relationship management experience.

- Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and relationship management skills.

- A proactive, independent mindset paired with high energy and a positive attitude.

- The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

BONUS POINTS FOR EXPERIENCE WITH THE FOLLOWING:

- Industry-specific sales within our target vertical.

- Implementing and executing MEDDPICC (or similar enterprise sales qualification methodologies).

- Selling enterprise software or cloud-based applications to large, complex organizations.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

description:
Overview
LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.
Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors-helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.
LMI is seeking a Functional Service Desk Agent with significant experience in DoW contracting to support the Army Contract Writing System (ACWS) as a member of the Tier 2 Functional Service Desk, sponsored by the Office of the Deputy Assistant Secretary of the Army (Procurement) (ODASA(P)). The candidate will provide direct functional support to the Army Contracting Enterprise. This position requires an Active Secret Clearance.
Responsibilities

• Provides subject matter expertise in federal acquisition and contracting to investigate, diagnose, and resolve functional incidents and service requests.

• Performs ticket triage within the Army Enterprise Service Management Platform (AESMP/ServiceNow): validates and adjusts priority based on impact and urgency, confirms categorization and tagging, identifies bundled or misrouted tickets, and takes ownership of tickets in order of priority.

• Authors, edits, and reviews Knowledge Based Articles (KBAs) and Knowledge Based Videos (KBVs) published in AESMP for both agents and end users; supports the periodic review of published knowledge content to ensure it is updated or rendered obsolete as the system evolves.

• Analyzes incident trends and issue clusters to support Problem Management, root cause analysis, and continual service improvement initiatives.

• Supports sustainment and execution of the ITIL service model framework in support of the contracting community.

• Communicates incident status and business impact to program stakeholders and leadership; participates in the development, review, and delivery of project artifacts and deliverables.

• Continuously evaluates and hones communication skills.

description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

 

THE ROLE

Portworx by Everpure is the leading global solution for unlocking the potential of Kubernetes by unlocking the power of data at enterprise scale.  Portworx is a cloud native platform that enterprises depend on to reduce the cost and complexity of rapidly deploying containerized applications across multiple clouds and on-prem environments.  By providing a single standard that works across the environment, we reduce the operating cost of kubernetes, unlock more use cases, respond and pivot to changes due to economic, regulatory and/or business impacts and make it easier to modernize applications, delight developers, and deliver innovation.

Via Portworx, you can manage any database or stateful service on any infrastructure using any container scheduler. You get a single data management layer for all of your stateful services, no matter where they run. And we thrive in multi-cloud environments.

We are looking for Kubernetes experts to help our team capture this massive and rapidly growing market opportunity.  This architect role will serve as the vanguard of the “Kubernetes Everywhere” movement. There’s no safe harbor here for those that can’t, don't, or won’t. There’s also no room for those that put “I” ahead of “We”.

We are customer first, we lead with integrity, and recognize that unlocking achievement requires engagement across the full spectrum of co-selling partners. We are builders, creators, and helping define the next generation of the world’s best modern data platform at Pure.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

The Portworx  Cloud Native Architect is a customer-facing role responsible for providing deep technical and business expertise to customers who want to run stateful applications in containers and automate “Day 2” data management workflows. This role requires candidates to be located in the NY/NJ area and willing to work from our NYC office two days per week.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• 5+ years' experience as a customer facing senior-level technical architect.

• Charismatic, confident, and likable self-starter with a track record of success on stage, in the spotlight, and with customers.

• Team oriented leader that is able to coach and drive desired behavior through influence rather than title.

• 5+ years of Linux Administration and/or Linux development experience with an industry recognized administration-level or higher certification.

• 3+ years of Kubernetes Administration experience and a KCNA (Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate) or above certification.

• Certification-level fluency in OpenShift, Rancher, or other Kubernetes orchestration environment.

• Certification-level fluency in Cloud IaaS environments such as VMware, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform and OpenStack.

• Certification-level fluency with DevOps concepts and hands-on experience with associated tools, such as; Ansible, Terraform, Docker, and CI/CD pipeline applications.

• Certification-level fluency in data engineering, big data, and database operations, delivery and operational services.

• Demonstrable understanding of data platform technologies as they relate to highly available business applications on-prem, hybrid, and in the cloud

• Demonstrable understanding of the enterprise application development lifecycle and container platforms’ effect on it.

title: Sales Operations Specialist
description:
About Us
At Prenuvo , we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".
This role owns how our sales process works across Direct-to-Consumer, Physician Partnerships, and Enterprise - how work flows, what the systems are asked to do, and what the sales organization sees when it opens them. It is the person who finds where reps lose time, designs a better way, and drives it into practice.
This role reports to the Director, Commercial Strategy and Operations and works as a close building partner to our Sales Operations Manager. The two roles design the commercial operating infrastructure together, with the Specialist bringing hands-on execution, workflow design, and a constant eye on where the process is costing reps time. This is a partnership, not a support function - you are expected to bring your own point of view on how things should work, not wait to be handed specifications.
How we work with Salesforce. Our IT team owns and maintains the Salesforce platform. Commercial owns the design: we determine what the business needs the system to do, build the proposals and requirements behind those changes, and partner with IT to implement them. This role works hands-on in the surface layer - reports, dashboards, list views, and the configuration available to us - and specifies everything deeper. Success here depends as much on writing a clear, well-justified proposal and shepherding it through a queue you do not control as it does on building things yourself.
The role also extends this thinking beyond Sales Operations. The same discipline - map the workflow, find the friction, redesign it, measure whether it helped - applies wherever the commercial organization touches other functions, including handoffs with Marketing, Clinical, Finance, Legal, and Sales Enablement. Where a process spans teams, this role is expected to see the whole of it rather than only the Sales-shaped part.
Prenuvo 's commercial function is still being built, so there is real ownership available here. The processes you design will be the ones the sales organization runs on as it scales.
This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).
Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!
What You'll Do
Workflow Design and Rep Efficiency

• Map how work actually flows through the sales process today across each channel, and identify where reps lose time to manual steps, duplicate entry, unclear handoffs, or waiting on someone else.

• Design improvements to sales workflows - automation, validation, templated processes, streamlined approvals, better-structured records - that measurably reduce the administrative burden on reps.

• Sit with reps and sales leaders regularly to understand where the process gets in their way, and translate what you hear into specific, well-defined change proposals.

• Apply the same workflow discipline to processes that extend beyond Sales Operations, partnering with Marketing, Clinical, Finance, Legal, and Sales Enablement to remove friction at the handoff points between teams.

• Track the time and effort cost of process changes, and be honest about which ones worked and which added complexity without benefit.

• Bring a continuous improvement mindset: treat the current process as a draft rather than a given.

title: Cyber Risk Advisory Senior Consultant
description:
About Coalfire
 
Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies all across the world navigate the ever-changing cybersecurity landscape. We are headquartered in Chicago, Illinois with offices across the U.S., Argentina, and the U.K.
 
But that’s not who we are - that’s just what we do.
 
We are thought leaders, consultants, and cybersecurity experts, but above all else, we are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are hungry to learn, grow, and make a difference.

Position Summary
The Cyber Risk Advisory (CRA) Senior Consultant leads day-to-day delivery of cybersecurity, privacy, AI, and information risk advisory engagements. Working with clients across industries, this role translates business objectives, regulatory obligations, and technical evidence into practical risk insights, prioritized recommendations, and actionable roadmaps. The Senior Consultant leads assessment workstreams, facilitates stakeholder interviews and workshops, and develops clear deliverables for executive and technical audiences. In close coordination with Project Managers, Directors, and delivery teams, this role manages scope, schedule, quality, and client expectations while coaching consultants and contributing to consistent delivery.

Why You’ll Want to Join Us
 
At Coalfire, you’ll find the support you need to thrive personally and professionally. In many cases, we provide a flexible work model that empowers you to choose when and where you’ll work most effectively - whether you’re at home or an office.
 
Regardless of location, you’ll experience a company that prioritizes connection and wellbeing and be part of a team where people care about each other and our communities. You’ll have opportunities to join employee resource groups, participate in in-person and virtual events, and more. And you’ll enjoy competitive perks and benefits to support you and your family, like paid parental leave, flexible time off, certification and training reimbursement, digital mental health and wellbeing support membership, and comprehensive insurance options.
 
At Coalfire, equal opportunity and pay equity is integral to the way we do business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Coalfire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, contact our Human Resources team at HumanResourcesMB@coalfire.com.

Headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia, we have approximately 50,000 employees in more than 70 countries across all 7 continents.

The Manager, Enterprise Communications & Channels is responsible for developing and delivering employee communication programs that inform, engage, and connect employees to Amentum 's business priorities, leaders, and culture. This role serves as a trusted communications partner to the corporate functions and business leaders, helping translate complex information into clear, compelling, and actionable employee communications.

title: Executive Assistant, Marketing
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

We’re looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to support our CMO, and VP’s in the marketing leadership team. This role will keep leaders focused and effective by managing complex calendars, travel, expenses, and inboxes while also helping build and improve Marketing’s operating rhythm.

This is a high-trust executive partnership that combines excellent administrative support with the judgment and follow-through to keep a busy CMO prepared, focused, and ahead of commitments. You’ll connect day-to-day executive support with Marketing’s leadership meetings, quarterly business reviews, planning cycles, and major events-turning priorities into organized preparation, clear communications, and reliable follow-through. You’ll coordinate closely with functional leaders and program owners, while the CMO and those leaders retain ownership of strategy, business decisions, and results.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

EXECUTIVE PARTNERSHIP AND PRIORITIZATION

- Manage complex calendars across time zones with an understanding of the CMO’s priorities, balancing leadership, cross-functional, customer, and external commitments while protecting time for preparation and focused work.

- Own travel coordination, detailed itineraries, expenses, and inbox organization for supported executives; anticipate changes and resolve conflicts with minimal direction.

- Maintain a regular planning check-in with the CMO to review upcoming commitments, decisions needed, preparation gaps, and follow-ups; surface risks early and recommend practical next steps.

- Partner with other executive assistants and the offices of senior leaders to coordinate sensitive, high-priority meetings and keep the right stakeholders informed.

- Serve as primary Executive Assistant support for Temporal’s CMO, and additive support for Vice-President’s within the CMO organization, particularly during busy travel seasons and key company events.

LEADERSHIP CADENCE, QBRS, AND PLANNING SUPPORT

- Coordinate Marketing leadership meetings, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), team-wide meetings, and planning sessions-from scheduling and agendas through pre-reads, decision capture, and follow-through.

- Work backward from leadership and QBR dates to set input deadlines, distribute templates, gather updates from functional owners, and schedule the CMO’s review time before materials are due.

- Organize team inputs into concise leadership materials that clearly distinguish results, risks, decisions needed, and next-quarter commitments; partner with Marketing Operations and Finance for validated metrics and financial inputs.

- Keep the CMO’s priority tracker, 1:1 agendas, and action and decision logs current, with clear owners and dates. Follow up across teams, flag stalled dependencies, and close the loop on commitments.

- Support annual and quarterly planning by coordinating milestones, stakeholder inputs, and review cycles, keeping documentation aligned with leadership decisions.

EXECUTIVE READINESS, COMMUNICATIONS, AND EVENTS

- Coordinate preparation for executive presentations, customer and partner meetings, speaking engagements, and major company or Marketing events. Build in early briefing conversations, draft reviews, and rehearsal time in partnership with content and event owners.

- Assemble concise briefing documents covering the purpose, audience, context, key messages, logistics, and decisions or actions needed; ensure the executive has current materials with time to prepare.

- Draft and refine internal communications, meeting recaps, presentations, and leadership updates in the CMO’s voice, coordinating contributions and approvals while handling sensitive information with discretion.

- Plan and execute Marketing team offsites and leadership gatherings, including agenda development with leaders, budgets, vendors, travel, attendee communications, and day-of logistics; carry decisions and commitments into follow-up tracking.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer (all genders)
description:
Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock.

As Senior Applied AI Engineer (all genders), you work like a forward deployed engineer, embedded with our internal teams. AI is reshaping how we work: you find where it has the highest impact, decide what is worth building, and then build it. You work closely with team leads across departments and within our Data & AI team.

The role combines discovery and hands-on engineering: you split your time between working with teams and building the solutions yourself. User pain points are often vague at first, and priorities change as we learn which use cases hold up. Once a solution works, you hand it over and move on to the next problem.

Pure coding, pure advisory work or polishing a single system for months are not part of the job. If turning unclear problems into working AI solutions is your thing, you’ll feel at home here.

As we are looking for a hands-on engineer, a coding interview is an integral part of our interview process.

What to expect

- Discovery: Shadow processes and interview the people doing the work. Quantify and validate where time and quality are lost.

- Prioritization: Prioritize use cases across departments by impact, not by what is easiest or needs the most advanced tooling, and say no to the ones that don’t hold up.

- Make or buy: Test existing tools and new AI providers against our use cases before building.

- Build and ship: Build the solution yourself: LLM based systems, traditional ML, rule based automation, or a combination, depending on the problem. Ship a first usable version within weeks, integrated into the tools people already use, and iterate based on feedback.

- Measure success: Define success upfront: business outcome, adoption and metrics that measure output quality.

- Own the outcome: Own each solution until it has a clear outcome: handed over to our Platform team or the domain team, or shut down.

- Platform: Build on our AI & Data platform and feed back what it needs next.

Inspire us by

- Background: 5+ years in software engineering, data science or ML engineering, including at least 1 year shipping LLM based products. Scale-up experience and close work with business teams such as operations or sales are a plus.

- Discovery experience: You have found and scoped problems yourself, working directly with users, and turned them into a quantified case for or against solving them.

- Technical skills: Strong Python skills and a solid understanding of core GenAI concepts and building blocks, including RAG, tool calling, MCP, agent frameworks, and evaluation (Evals). Experience with traditional machine learning techniques (e.g., XGBoost) and SQL is a plus.

- End-to-end delivery: You have taken at least one AI project from an unclear business problem to production, implemented it end to end and can show how you measured its output quality.

- Analytical thinking & communication: You bring structure to ambiguous problems and explain technical trade-offs to non technical teams. You defend your decisions on which use cases to pursue and work as an equal with stakeholders.

- Mindset: Proactive and comfortable driving topics in unclear situations. You don’t wait for requirements, you find the problem worth solving.

- Language skills: Fluent English (C1); German is a plus.

What we offer

- Flexibility & Responsibility: Your workday, your performance - Our hybrid model empowers you to focus from home, get fresh perspectives during workation, and connect in person during our Anchor Days (Tuesday to Thursday)

- Tailored Mobility: Full speed ahead - Whether it’s sustainable bike leasing or a public transport subsidy, we keep you flexible and on the move
